boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Ten documented Touro University milestones and recurring school traditions, spanning New York-based professional schools and university-wide research.

cards.title: NYCPM White Coat Ceremony
cards.subtitle: New York College of Podiatric Medicine
cards.notes: Look for the incoming class’s September ceremony, where students receive inaugural coats and recite the Hippocratic Oath.
cards.short_summary: NYCPM’s annual symbolic entry into podiatric medicine.
cards.evidence_claim: NYCPM describes this as the country’s first podiatric medical school to hold an annual White Coat Ceremony; new students receive coats and recite the Hippocratic Oath each September.
cards.access_notes: A school milestone for the incoming NYCPM class; consult NYCPM for ceremony access details.

cards.title: NYCPM Residency Fair
cards.subtitle: New York College of Podiatric Medicine
cards.notes: Attend as a student planning next steps: the annual fair brings residency-program information into the NYCPM calendar.
cards.short_summary: An annual residency-planning milestone for NYCPM students.
cards.evidence_claim: NYCPM identifies its Residency Fair as an annual opportunity for students to learn about residency programs while planning their next steps.
cards.access_notes: Intended for NYCPM students; confirm participation arrangements with the school.

cards.title: NYCPM Research Fair
cards.subtitle: New York College of Podiatric Medicine
cards.notes: Prepare a poster if you conduct research; this student-initiated, student-organized annual fair is the showcase moment.
cards.short_summary: A yearly poster showcase organized by NYCPM students.
cards.evidence_claim: NYCPM says it hosts a student-initiated and organized college research fair every year for students to showcase research posters.
cards.access_notes: Participation is tied to NYCPM research activity; ask the school about current submission requirements.

cards.title: NYCPM Match Day
cards.subtitle: New York College of Podiatric Medicine
cards.notes: Fourth-year podiatric students learn their residency matches together in March, surrounded by classmates and faculty.
cards.short_summary: The annual day NYCPM fourth-years learn residency placements.
cards.evidence_claim: NYCPM describes Match Day as an annual March milestone when fourth-year students find out their residency programs alongside classmates and faculty.
cards.access_notes: For NYCPM fourth-year students; event access is managed by the college.

cards.title: NYCPM Commencement at Lincoln Center
cards.subtitle: New York College of Podiatric Medicine
cards.notes: Mark four years of podiatric training at the school’s graduation ceremony, held at Lincoln Center according to NYCPM.
cards.short_summary: NYCPM’s graduation milestone at Lincoln Center.
cards.evidence_claim: NYCPM states that, after four years, its students participate in the graduation ceremony and receive diplomas at Lincoln Center.
cards.access_notes: For graduating NYCPM students and invited guests; confirm current ceremony arrangements with NYCPM.

cards.title: TouroCOM White Coat Ceremony
cards.subtitle: Touro College of Osteopathic Medicine
cards.notes: Watch for the school’s scheduled White Coat Ceremony, where incoming students are ceremonially coated before medical training begins.
cards.short_summary: A TouroCOM ceremony marking entry into medical school.
cards.evidence_claim: TouroCOM’s official ceremony page lists annual 2026 ceremonies, specifies that attendance is required, and explains the student coating process.
cards.access_notes: Attendance is required for students; guest tickets and venue details vary by campus and are set by TouroCOM.

cards.entity_name: Touro College of Pharmacy White Coat Ceremony
cards.title: Pharmacy White-Coat Cloaking
cards.subtitle: Touro College of Pharmacy
cards.notes: Follow the Class of 2029 example: faculty cloak future pharmacists in white coats before they take professional oaths.
cards.short_summary: Touro pharmacy students are cloaked and take professional oaths.
cards.evidence_claim: Touro reported that the College of Pharmacy Class of 2029 was cloaked in white coats by faculty at its ceremony and then took professional oaths.
cards.source_title: Class of 2029 Touro College of Pharmacy Welcomed to the Profession at White Coat Ceremony
cards.access_notes: Ceremony participation is organized by the College of Pharmacy; check current student-affairs guidance.

cards.entity_name: Touro College of Dental Medicine White Coat Ceremony
cards.title: Dental School’s Clinic White-Coat Step
cards.subtitle: Touro College of Dental Medicine
cards.notes: Recognize the transition from simulation work to supervised clinic training when the dental class dons white coats.
cards.short_summary: A dental-school milestone moving students into clinic training.
cards.evidence_claim: Touro College of Dental Medicine states that its Class of 2026 donned white coats in a ceremony marking the move from classroom and simulation lab to supervised clinic training.
cards.access_notes: A professional-school milestone; current participation and guest details are determined by TCDM.

cards.entity_name: Touro College of Dental Medicine Dental Oath
cards.title: The Dental Oath at Commencement
cards.subtitle: Touro College of Dental Medicine
cards.notes: At the dental commencement, notice the formal administration of the Dental Oath following the presentation of degree candidates.
cards.short_summary: A formal oath within TCDM’s commencement program.
cards.evidence_claim: Touro College of Dental Medicine’s 2025 commencement program includes “Administration of the Dental Oath” after the presentation and introduction of degree candidates.
cards.source_title: Touro College of Dental Medicine Commencement Program
cards.access_notes: Part of TCDM’s formal commencement program; access follows commencement arrangements.

cards.title: Touro University Research Day
cards.subtitle: University-wide research showcase
cards.notes: Use the annual event to see student and faculty scholarship brought together across Touro schools and campuses.
cards.short_summary: A recurring university-wide showcase of Touro research.
cards.evidence_claim: Touro’s Research Day news page says the university hosts a research day each year showcasing student and faculty research across schools and campuses.
cards.access_notes: Event format and access can vary by year; check Touro Research Day announcements for current details.
